title: Towards an Australian Circular Economy for Solar Photovoltaic Technologies
summary_en: By 2035, more than 1 million tonnes of solar panels will be decommissioned, presenting Australia with an urgent reuse and recycling challenge. This report maps pathways to a circular photovoltaic economy through policy, technology and market reform.
title_cn: Towards an Australian Circular Economy for Solar Photovoltaic Technologies

title: Towards an Australian Circular Economy for Solar Photovoltaic Technologies: A Policy Brief for Government, Industry and Research Stakeholders
summary_en: Australia’s solar panel installation boom will generate a wave of waste—and the window to address it is closing. This brief summarizes the problem, outlines five pathways to a circular economy and offers three priority recommendations for government.
title_cn: Towards an Australian Circular Economy for Solar Photovoltaic Technologies: A Policy Brief for Government, Industry and Research Stakeholders
